category_title: Six-year-old girl with PDD-NOS exhibiting behavioral obsessions and communication delays
minimal_context: The student is responding to teacher instructions during a class observation while the teacher holds a reinforcer.
dialogue:
TUTOR: Touch the picture of the cat.

STUDENT: (Touches the picture correctly and looks expectantly at the teacher's hand holding the reinforcer.)

TUTOR: Okay. Now touch the picture of the dog.

STUDENT: I want.

TUTOR: We need to finish this first.

STUDENT: Give! (Starts crying, tries to snatch the reinforcer from the teacher's hand, and hits the teacher's arm when it is not provided instantly.)

options.A: Ask the student if she is having difficulties.
options.B: Provide the reinforcer right after the behavior.
options.C: Provide a detailed instruction of each specific element in the task.
options.D: Explain a concept, demonstrate a principle, or model a skill.
